la:verb:vieo.gloss: to bend or twist, plait, weave
senses: to bend or twist, plait, weave
la:verb:vieo.html:
vĭĕo, no
perf., ētum, 2, v. a.
root in Sanscr. vjā-, cover; Gr. ἴτυς, border; cf. Lat. vitex, vitta, vimen, vitis, etc.
, to bend or twist together, to plait, weave (ante-class.): viere vincire: a quo est in Sota Ennii: Ibant malaci viere Veneriam corollam, Müll. ( Vahl.); cf. Müll.; : ut habeas vimina, unde viendo quid facias, ut sirpeas, vallos, crates,.— Hence, vĭētus (per synæresin scanned as a dissyl., ), a, um, P. a., prop., bent together, bent up; hence, shrunken, shrivelled, withered, wrinkled (cf. viesco): aliquid vietum et caducum,: membra,: ficus,.—Transf.: cor,: senex,: vestis,decayed,.
